About this reading. The short source statements are our paraphrases, divided at mathematical moves rather than printed line breaks. Section numbers refer to Euler’s text; the linked PDF includes John D. Blanton’s English translation and points to the 1748 Latin original. Euler treats infinitely small and infinitely large quantities directly. When a step uses them, the explanation gives its modern limiting interpretation. This reading covers §§114–125, the complete Chapter VII. The Latin view gives a checked short passage from the relevant numbered section in modernized spelling, plus a link to the complete original page; its excerpt is repeated where a section is split into multiple mathematical moves. The English view is our explanatory paraphrase, not Blanton’s translation.
